services.heading: Services
services.tagline: Visual design for meaningful events and intentional brands.

eventDesign.title: Event Design
eventDesign.tagline: Invitations, menus, and event details that feel cohesive and intentional.
eventDesign.description: From invitations and menus to signage and every detail in between — we design event materials that feel cohesive and intentional. Each piece is crafted to reflect the tone, palette, and personality of your celebration, creating a seamless visual experience for your guests.

weddingExperience.title: Wedding Experience
weddingExperience.tagline: A curated digital and visual identity for your wedding.
weddingExperience.description: Your wedding deserves its own visual identity. We create a curated digital and print experience — from save-the-dates and invitations to day-of details and keepsakes — all designed to tell your story with elegance and intention.

brandDesign.title: Brand Design
brandDesign.tagline: Strategic and aesthetic design for brands that want to stand out.
brandDesign.description: We build brands that are both strategic and beautiful. From logo design and color palettes to brand guidelines and visual systems, we help you create a cohesive identity that resonates with your audience and stands out in your market.

creativeSupport.title: Creative Support
creativeSupport.tagline: Content and photography that complements the overall vision.
creativeSupport.description: Sometimes you just need an extra pair of creative hands. We offer content creation, photography, and visual support that complements your existing brand or project — ensuring everything stays aligned with your overall vision.

about.heading: Who is 6 del 8
